_meta.note: Technology-level validation library. Each index's evidence.tier maps to a technology id via tier_to_technology. Caveats included for DD honesty.

technologies.name: VitalAge — Multi-Omics Actuarial Biological Age
technologies.claim_summary: Converts multi-modal biometric inputs into a population-calibrated Physiological Age via actuarial mortality mapping rather than linear z-score summation.
method: Actuarial mortality-mapping (PhenoAge framework, Levine et al. 2018): biological age = chronological age of the reference cohort whose all-cause mortality risk equals the individual's computed composite risk.
Competing-risks product aggregation, bounded [0,1), modeling non-linear cross-domain interactions.
Quality Integrity Firewall (QIF): real-time cross-modal sensor validation gating implausible readings.

7-stage pipeline: acquisition → QIF → behavioral anchor synthesis → gated modular computation → non-linear cross-domain integration → competing-risks transform → actuarial age mapping with uncertainty propagation.

metrics.note: ~11% relative improvement over single-domain blood PhenoAge

publications: Bortz et al. Commun Biol 2023 (UKBB C-index 0.778)
technologies.source_doc: LifeNome Multiomics Enhanced VitalAge Technology White Paper
honest_caveats: C-index 0.778 is the published cohort benchmark, not necessarily a prospective validation of Lifenome's specific composite on an independent hold-out.
Targets stated as '≥0.78' / 'significant at p<0.05' are design targets in the white paper's metrics table.

technologies.name: Facial Biological Age (methylation-correlated)
technologies.claim_summary: Smartphone-camera facial image → biological-age estimate correlated to methylation-clock signals.
method: Face-image features (periorbital, texture, wrinkle, symmetry) mapped to methylation-age correlates.
patents: US20240371202A1 — facial biological age from methylation markers + face image
publications: Vladimir, Perišić et al. Epigenetics insights from perceived facial aging, Clinical Epigenetics 2023 (featured in New Scientist)
technologies.source_doc: Genomics AI white papers; VitalAge white paper
honest_caveats: Camera-derived age is presented as correlated with methylation/epigenetic signal, not a direct methylation assay.

technologies.name: Genomics AI — Polygenic Risk Scoring
technologies.claim_summary: Polygenic scores estimate predisposition across many conditions via cumulative variant effects, combined with dynamic network analysis + machine learning.
method: Polygenic phenotypic-trait predisposition via dynamic network analysis + ML (patented).

API outputs per trait: risk score (low/med/high), percentile vs reference, odds ratio for top-10% vs bottom-50% PRS, predisposing variants (SNPs), tested genes, coverage reliability score, scientific references.

metrics.value: per-trait variants, genes, percentile, OR(top10%/bottom50%), coverage reliability

patents: US20200026822A1 — polygenic trait predisposition via dynamic network analysis + ML (2018)
publications: Perišić et al. PRS & risk factors for Gestational Diabetes, J Pers Med 2022
Perišić et al. PRS & risk factors for Preeclampsia/Gestational Hypertension, J Pers Med 2022
technologies.source_doc: Empowering Personalized Medicine / Longevity / Wellbeing; Exome Clinical Reporting; MultiModal Clinical Risk Assessment
honest_caveats: PRS portability across ancestries is a general field limitation; per-trait validation strength varies by trait.
Coverage reliability score reflects genotype completeness, not predictive validity of the score.

technologies.name: Pregnancy & Nutrition Personalization PRS
technologies.claim_summary: PRS-driven risk assessment and personalized nutrition for preconception/pregnancy/postpartum.
method: Condition-specific PRS (e.g., gestational diabetes) feeding personalized nutrition optimization.
patents: US20230187079A1 — gestational diabetes risk + personalized nutrition
publications: Perišić et al. J Pers Med 2022 (gestational diabetes PRS)
honest_caveats: Nutrition-plan efficacy claims are method/patent descriptions, not outcome-trial results.

technologies.name: Composite / Heuristic Indices
technologies.claim_summary: Lifestyle, blood, wearable and mixed-input scores combined via stated weighting formulas.
method: Transparent weighted formulas over normalized constituent biomarkers (formula shown per index).
publications: Evidence rests on the published literature of each constituent biomarker, not a Lifenome white paper.
honest_caveats: These are the majority of indices (~172/260). Weighting coefficients are design choices; treat as decision-support heuristics absent index-level outcome validation.

technologies.name: Exome+ Clinical Reporting
technologies.claim_summary: Automated clinical interpretation of whole-exome (VCF) data into ACMG-tiered findings across 132 panels / 14 medical domains.
method: WES VCF → variant annotation via curated gene panels (CGD, ClinGen, DECIPHER/DDG2P, BabySeq G2P) + variant repositories (HGMD, ClinVar).
ACMG pathogenicity classification (Pathogenic / Likely Pathogenic / VUS).
Structured report: primary findings, secondary (medically actionable) findings, VUS, per-variant annotations (gene, transcript, zygosity, effect, ACMG tier, allele freq, in-silico, literature).

metrics.value: 132 panels across 14 medical domains; 3,096 unique traits

technologies.source_doc: Exome + Clinical Reporting on the Lifenome Genomics AI Platform (White Paper, Jul 2025)
honest_caveats: Per the white paper, several pipeline stages are marked 'in development': gnomAD population filtering, in-silico prediction (SIFT/PolyPhen-2/MutationTaster), and phenotype mapping.
Coverage reliability score reflects genotype completeness, not clinical validity.
Intended for physician/clinician review; not an autonomous diagnostic.

technologies.name: WGS Polygenic Precision Medicine
technologies.claim_summary: Polygenic risk scoring applied to whole-genome input for precision-medicine trait predisposition.
method: Genotype (WGS) → polygenic scores via the dynamic-network-analysis + ML method (US20200026822A1).
Per-trait outputs mirror the array PRS engine: risk score, percentile, OR(top10%/bottom50%), variants, genes, coverage reliability.
publications: Perišić et al. J Pers Med 2022 (PRS validation examples)
technologies.source_doc: WGS Polygenic Precision Medicine Report (White Paper)
honest_caveats: PRS ancestry portability is a general field limitation; per-trait validation strength varies.
WGS vs array differ in input breadth, not in the underlying scoring method's validation.
